question.en: Which animal can survive in the vacuum of space for a short time?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup dalam vakum angkasa untuk masa yang singkat?

funFact.en: Tardigrades can survive extreme radiation, vacuum, and freezing conditions.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade boleh hidup dalam radiasi, vakum dan suhu beku yang ekstrem.

question.en: Which planet in our solar system has winds faster than the speed of sound?
question.ms: Planet manakah mempunyai angin lebih laju daripada kelajuan bunyi?

funFact.en: Neptune’s winds can reach over 2,000 km/h.
funFact.ms: Angin di Neptun boleh mencapai lebih 2,000 km/j.

question.en: Which mammal has the slowest heartbeat of any land animal?
question.ms: Mamalia manakah mempunyai degupan jantung paling perlahan di darat?

funFact.en: A sloth’s heart rate can drop below 40 beats per minute.
funFact.ms: Degupan jantung sloth boleh turun bawah 40 denyutan seminit.

question.en: Which bird can stay in the air for months without landing?
question.ms: Burung manakah boleh berada di udara selama berbulan-bulan tanpa mendarat?

funFact.en: Common swifts eat, sleep, and mate while flying.
funFact.ms: Swift biasa makan, tidur dan mengawan ketika terbang.

question.en: Which tree species can live for more than 5,000 years?
question.ms: Spesies pokok manakah boleh hidup lebih 5,000 tahun?

funFact.en: Some bristlecone pines are among the oldest living organisms on Earth.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah pain bristlecone antara organisma hidup tertua di Bumi.

question.en: Which ocean animal has the largest brain of any invertebrate?
question.ms: Haiwan laut manakah mempunyai otak terbesar antara invertebrata?

funFact.en: Octopuses can solve puzzles and open jars.
funFact.ms: Gurita boleh menyelesaikan teka-teki dan membuka balang.

question.en: Which animal has the longest pregnancy of any mammal?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai tempoh kehamilan paling lama antara mamalia?

funFact.en: Elephant pregnancies last about 22 months.
funFact.ms: Kehamilan gajah berlangsung kira-kira 22 bulan.

question.en: Which fish can survive out of water by breathing through its skin?
question.ms: Ikan manakah boleh hidup di luar air dengan bernafas melalui kulit?

funFact.en: Mudskippers spend much of their time walking on land.
funFact.ms: Mudskipper menghabiskan banyak masa berjalan di darat.

question.en: Which animal has the longest migration of any mammal?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai migrasi paling jauh antara mamalia?

funFact.en: Gray whales travel about 20,000 km each year.
funFact.ms: Paus kelabu berhijrah kira-kira 20,000 km setiap tahun.

question.en: Which insect produces the loudest sound relative to its body size?
question.ms: Serangga manakah menghasilkan bunyi paling kuat berbanding saiz badannya?

funFact.en: Cicadas can produce sounds over 100 decibels.
funFact.ms: Cicada boleh menghasilkan bunyi lebih 100 desibel.

question.en: Which animal has the strongest bite force among living animals?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai daya gigitan paling kuat antara haiwan hidup?

funFact.en: Saltwater crocodiles have the strongest bite recorded in animals.
funFact.ms: Buaya air masin mempunyai gigitan paling kuat pernah direkodkan.

question.en: Which animal has eyes bigger than its brain?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai mata lebih besar daripada otaknya?

funFact.en: Ostrich eyes are the largest of any land animal.
funFact.ms: Mata burung unta adalah yang terbesar antara haiwan darat.

question.en: Which plant can close its leaves instantly when touched?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah boleh menutup daun dengan segera apabila disentuh?

funFact.en: The plant folds its leaves as a defense mechanism.
funFact.ms: Tumbuhan ini melipat daunnya sebagai mekanisme pertahanan.

question.en: Which sea creature can regenerate almost its entire body from a small fragment?
question.ms: Makhluk laut manakah boleh menumbuhkan semula hampir seluruh badan dari serpihan kecil?

funFact.en: Some starfish can regenerate a full body from a single arm.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah bintang laut boleh menumbuhkan seluruh badan dari satu lengan.

question.en: Which animal can detect electrical signals produced by other animals?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh mengesan isyarat elektrik yang dihasilkan haiwan lain?

funFact.en: Sharks use organs called ampullae of Lorenzini.
funFact.ms: Hiu menggunakan organ dipanggil ampullae of Lorenzini.

question.en: Which bird has the largest wingspan of any living bird?
question.ms: Burung manakah mempunyai rentang sayap terbesar antara burung hidup?

funFact.en: The wandering albatross wingspan can exceed 3.5 meters.
funFact.ms: Rentang sayap albatros pengembara boleh melebihi 3.5 meter.

question.en: Which desert rodent never drinks water in its lifetime?
question.ms: Tikus gurun manakah tidak pernah minum air sepanjang hidupnya?

funFact.en: Kangaroo rats get all the water they need from seeds.
funFact.ms: Tikus kangaroo mendapat semua air daripada biji yang dimakan.

question.en: Which ocean trench is the deepest place on Earth?
question.ms: Parit laut manakah paling dalam di Bumi?

funFact.en: The Mariana Trench reaches depths of nearly 11 km.
funFact.ms: Parit Mariana mencapai kedalaman hampir 11 km.

question.en: Which animal has the longest lifespan among mammals?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai jangka hayat paling panjang antara mamalia?

funFact.en: Bowhead whales can live over 200 years.
funFact.ms: Paus bowhead boleh hidup lebih 200 tahun.

question.en: Which animal can rotate its head up to 270 degrees?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh memusingkan kepala sehingga 270 darjah?

funFact.en: Owls have special blood vessels that protect their brains during rotation.
funFact.ms: Burung hantu mempunyai saluran darah khas untuk melindungi otaknya ketika memusingkan kepala.
